prompt.primaryRequest: Create one full-body v3 candidate of Yui for ヨルノシルベ using both references as identity authority. This is candidate-only concept art, not Story Canon, final art or runtime art.
prompt.subject: A balanced young-adult human woman with a soft oval face, rounded cheeks, non-pointed chin, smaller almost-level almond-round brown eyes, tapered double eyelids, soft straight brows, gently rounded nose, medium mouth, asymmetric warm-dark brown bob with one ear exposed by a tuck, and a gentle smile with two unmistakable shallow cheek dimples. The dimples are smile indentations, not freckles or blush dots.
prompt.composition: Front-facing or very shallow three-quarter full body, hood worn up and clearly framing the face, half-step forward. The lantern leads the path while the found paper is carefully checked and offered toward another person. Keep the full silhouette and both hands clearly visible for body-side verification.
equipmentContinuity: Yui's anatomical RIGHT hand holds the lantern.
In the front-facing view, the lantern and anatomical right arm appear on the VIEWER'S LEFT.
The strap begins at Yui's anatomical RIGHT shoulder, VIEWER'S LEFT in front view.
The strap crosses the chest and ends at Yui's anatomical LEFT waist, VIEWER'S RIGHT in front view.
The small bag rests at Yui's anatomical LEFT waist, VIEWER'S RIGHT.
Yui's anatomical LEFT hand, VIEWER'S RIGHT, holds or offers the found paper.
Do not mirror, swap, hand-transfer or hide these placements.
prompt.costume: Short practical navy hooded outer layer, curved soft travel layers, old-paper cream inner clothing, worn practical boots, small body-left bag and aged blackened-brass lantern. Reduce bow, ruffle, belt and dangling-charm density. Any gold marks are sparse broken repair stitches only.
prompt.style: Premium Japanese storybook character concept art; matte gouache, watercolor and pencil/ink texture; restrained detail; quiet night fill and one small local warm lantern light; suitable for later pixel-sprite simplification.
avoid: child, baby, loli or doll proportions
generic anime heroine face, giant round eyes or pointed V jaw
hood down in the main pose
wrong body-side lantern, strap or bag
